climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune village in Burgundy, making more than 85% red wine from Pinot Noir and the rest white from Chardonnay. It has no Grand Cru vineyards, and most of its white wines are 100% Chardonnay.
